CommonLifecycleModel.description:
Lifecycle phases for common models.

Maps phase names to phase configurations. Phase names follow the pattern ``{command}_{action}_{suffix}``, e.g. ``deploy_plan_before``, ``deploy_provision``, ``deploy_destroy_after``, ``config_clear``. This is an open map (any phase name is allowed) rather than a fixed set of fields, since each kind and provisioner type defines its own set of supported phases.

CommonLifecyclePhaseModel.description: Lifecycle phase configuration: a description plus its scripts.

scripts.description: Scripts to run. Each entry is a path relative to the solution root, with one of the extensions bash, go, js, mjs, ps1, py, sh, or an object with `file`, `scope`, `priority` and `target`.

ResourceDependencyModel.description: A capability a resource needs, described by category (and optionally subcategory and resource type) rather than by name, for example category `networking` with subcategory `virtual_network`. Documentation only for now: strata does not yet resolve or enforce dependencies.

category.description: Resource category required (e.g., networking, compute, database, storage, security)

subcategory.description: Optional subcategory for more specific requirements (e.g., virtual_network, private_dns, nosql, blob)

resource_type.description: Optional specific resource type for even more granular matching (e.g., cosmosdb_account, storage_account)

description.description: Human-readable explanation of why this dependency exists

optional.description: If True, workspace can deploy without this dependency

ResourceDiskModel.description: Model for defining resource disk configuration (size, label, mount). Validates label format and mount path.

name.description: Optional disk name, unique within the resource.

size.description: Disk size must be greater than 0 GB

label.description: Disk label: letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter or digit. `${.name}` is replaced by the resource name and is the only substitution allowed.

mount.description: Absolute mount path, without `..`. The root `/` and system directories such as `/etc`, `/usr` and `/var/run` are not allowed.

ResourceMetaModel.description: Model for resource metadata (name, annotations, labels, tags).

tags.description: Optional tags (list of values for categorization)

ResourceSpecModel.description: What a resource is: its `provider_type` and `resource_type`, optional category and storage, free-form settings and tags. A workspace instantiates it under a role and can override `configuration`, `custom` and the tags.

lifecycle.description: Hook scripts per phase name. Accepted and validated, but strata does not run lifecycle hooks yet.

provider_type.description: Provider type this resource belongs to, for example `azure`. Must be the name of a ProviderConfig document.

resource_type.description: Type of the resource within its provider type, for example `storage_account`. Must be listed in that ProviderConfig's `resources`, unless it allows additional resources.

unit_cost.description: Cost of one unit of this resource, passed to Terraform as `unit_cost`. Strata does not interpret it.

category.description: Resource category for organization (e.g., networking, compute, database, storage)

subcategory.description: Resource subcategory for finer classification (e.g., vnet, nosql, blob)

dependencies.description: Capabilities this resource needs. Documentation only for now: strata does not resolve or enforce them.

storage.description:
Disks and volumes, for resources that need persistent storage such as virtual machines, containers and databases.

Rules:
- Disk names, disk labels and disk mount points must each be unique.
- Volume names must be unique.
- When disks are declared, every volume `path` must be under one of the disk mount points.

configuration.description: Free-form settings for this resource type, passed to Terraform as `strata.resources.<name>.configuration`. A workspace's own `configuration` for the resource overrides keys. Strata does not validate the keys itself: add an `attributeconfig` with `target.kind: resource` and `target.block: configuration` to do so (selector example: `spec.resource_type: storage_account`).

custom.description: Free-form values for your own scripts and Terraform code, passed to Terraform as `strata.resources.<name>.custom`; a workspace's own `custom` overrides keys. Strata does not interpret them. Validate them with an `attributeconfig` targeting `resource` and `custom`.

default_tags.description: Baseline cloud tags for this resource (for example `cost-center`, `environment`, `owner`), passed to Terraform as `strata.resources.<name>.default_tags`. Not the same as `meta.tags`, which is a free-form list for documentation. Strata does not limit the number of tags, so stay within your cloud provider's limit. A workspace can add to or override them.

custom_tags.description: Additional cloud tags on top of `default_tags`, for one-off needs. A workspace can add to or override them.

ResourceStorageModel.description:
Generic storage configuration for resources that need persistent storage. Applies to VMs, containers, databases, etc.

Rules:
- Disk names, disk labels and disk mount points must each be unique.
- Volume names must be unique.
- When disks are declared, every volume `path` must be under one of the disk mount points.

ResourceVolumesModel.description: Model for defining resource volume mounts (name, path).

ScriptPathModel.description: Individual script with scope and execution metadata.

scope.description: Execution scope - determines how many times the script runs (e.g. deployment, environment, workspace, provider, resource, module, namespace)

priority.description: Execution order within scope (lower runs first)

description: A deployable infrastructure building block, for example a virtual machine, storage account or key vault: its provider type, resource type, optional storage and default settings. A workspace instantiates it by name under a role.
